1	import React from 'react';
2	import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
3	import { Link as RouteLink } from 'react-router-dom';
4	import { defineMessages, useIntl } from 'react-intl';
5	import { ZimmProductName } from '../../atoms/zimmProductName';
6	import { ZimmProductPrice } from '../../atoms/zimmProductPrice';
7	import { ZimmIcon } from '../../atoms/zimmIcon';
8	import { ZimmSizeChipGroup } from '../zimmSizeChipGroup';
9	import type { ZimmSizeChipValue } from '../zimmSizeChipGroup';
10	import { CARD_SLOT } from '../../zimmProductCardShared';
11	
12	/**
13	 * Selector contract for a later step (the ZimmProductCard organism, SFCC-236 Step 6): stable
14	 * `data-card-slot` values on this component's own DOM so that organism's own recipe can target
15	 * these descendants for hover-reveal styling without reaching into implementation details.
16	 * Do not rename these values without updating that recipe too — mirrors the same contract
17	 * `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` documents for its own slots:
18	 *   - "content"   — the outermost element (this component's root).
19	 *   - "price"     — the price wrapper. Always rendered regardless of variation; the organism's
20	 *                   own CSS is what shows/hides it on hover per variation (see the `showBag`/
21	 *                   `showSizeChips` props below), not this component.
22	 *   - "sizeChips" — the size-chip-group wrapper (present only when `showSizeChips` is true).
23	 *                   Always rendered in the DOM per Figma's `hidden=true` default on the "Size
24	 *                   Selector instance" node — the organism's hover-reveal CSS is what handles
25	 *                   visibility, not this component's own recipe (see zimmProductCardContent.css.ts).
26	 *   - "bag"       — the bag-button wrapper (present only when `showBag` is true). Added later
27	 *                   than the three above, for the organism's own mobile-breakpoint hide rule
28	 *                   (Figma: PLP/PDP's Mobile Card-content instances have the bag icon's `Icons`
29	 *                   frame `hidden="true"`; Desktop and Wishlist's own Mobile instance do not) — a
30	 *                   viewport-width concern, not a hover one, but the same
31	 *                   "this component always renders it, the organism's CSS decides visibility"
32	 *                   division of responsibility as the other slots.
33	 */
34	
35	// Same import base SFCC's own swatch-group/swatch.jsx uses for its `RouteLink`, and the same
36	// reasoning zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx already documents: a router `Link` delivers "URL updates
37	// without a full page reload" for real. Confirmed directly (no overrides/app/components/link/
38	// directory exists on disk) — there is no overrides/.../link equivalent to reuse instead.
39	const ProductNameLink = chakra(RouteLink);
40	
41	const messages = defineMessages({
42	  // Deliberately generic, not name-interpolated ("Add {name} to bag") — no such requirement was
43	  // given, and the visible product name already sits immediately to this button's left in the
44	  // same row, so the accessible name does not need to repeat it.
45	  addToBag: { id: 'product_card_content.bag.add_to_bag', defaultMessage: 'Add to bag' },
46	  // Figma node 40002163:41468 (Desktop, Hover, PLP/PDP, Unavailable=True) — an instance of the
47	  // shared CTA/Link atom (40001908:28374/40001908:28368) with its text swapped to "NOTIFY ME" in
48	  // this state. Authored here in sentence case, not literal caps, matching this codebase's
49	  // pattern of keeping translatable copy normal-case and letting the textStyle's CSS apply the
50	  // visual transform (see ZimmProductName's own normal-cased stories against `productNames`'
51	  // textTransform: 'uppercase') — `linkSm` was corrected to `textTransform: 'uppercase'` to
52	  // match (2026-09-03, theme/foundation/typography.ts), so this renders "NOTIFY ME" correctly.
53	  notifyMe: {
54	    id: 'product_card_content.notify_me.label',
55	    defaultMessage: 'Notify me',
56	  },
57	});
58	
59	const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_CONTENT_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCardContent';
60	
61	/**
62	 * `ZimmProductName`'s own heading-level prop, read off the atom's real signature via a utility
63	 * type rather than a hand-typed duplicate union (typescript.md: "prefer utility types over
64	 * hand-rolled duplicate shapes... a hand-copied type silently drifts from its source when the
65	 * original changes"). Its type param is `'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3'` — note this is NOT `'h2' | 'h3' |
66	 * 'h4'` as an earlier sketch of this component's contract assumed; see `headingLevel` below.
67	 */
68	type ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel = React.ComponentProps<typeof ZimmProductName>['as'];
69	
70	export type ZimmProductCardContentProps = {
71	  /** The product's display name, rendered as the card's heading and link text. */
72	  name: string;
73	  /**
74	   * Heading level for the composed `ZimmProductName`, forwarded to it as `as`. Named
75	   * `headingLevel` here (rather than `as`) because this component is not itself polymorphic —
76	   * it always renders the same fixed element tree, it just hands the one real heading a level.
77	   * Typed as `ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel` (`'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3'`) to exactly match what that atom
78	   * actually accepts — a prior sketch of this contract assumed `'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4'`, which is
79	   * wrong on both ends: the atom has no `'h4'` at all, and it does accept `'h1'` (unlikely in
80	   * practice for a grid card, but not this component's place to forbid what the atom allows).
81	   */
82	  headingLevel: ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel;
83	  /**
84	   * PDP destination for the product name link. Not passed through `isSafeHref` — unlike
85	   * `ZimmNavItem`/`ZimmContactIconRow`'s CMS-sourced hrefs, this is an SFCC-generated product URL,
86	   * the same trust level `ZimmColourSwatch`'s own `href` prop already assumes.
87	   */
88	  href: string;
89	  /** Passed straight through to the composed `ZimmProductPrice`. */
90	  currentPrice?: string;
91	  /** Passed straight through to the composed `ZimmProductPrice`. */
92	  originalPrice?: string;
93	  /** Passed straight through to `ZimmProductPrice`'s own `isLoading`. */
94	  isPriceLoading?: boolean;
95	
96	  /**
97	   * Wishlist-only attributes line (colour + size as plain text), per the organism's
98	   * VARIATION_CONFIG (Step 6, not built yet) — this component only ever sees the resolved
99	   * boolean, never a variation name. When false the row is absent from the DOM entirely, not
100	   * merely visually hidden.
101	   */
102	  showAttributes: boolean;
103	  /**
104	   * Rendered only when `showAttributes` is true. Pass the plain colour value ("Ivory", not
105	   * "Ivory,") — the component itself appends the trailing comma when rendering, matching
106	   * Figma's own text-node structure (confirmed via get_design_context on node 40002187:58446:
107	   * the colour text node's own content literally includes the trailing comma, e.g. "Lilac
108	   * Sand,", not a separate punctuation node). See the `colourWithComma` derivation below.
109	   */
110	  colour?: string;
111	  /** Rendered only when `showAttributes` is true. */
112	  size?: string;
113	
114	  /** Renders the bag button (Figma "Icon_bag" — confirmed a bag action, not a wishlist star). */
115	  showBag: boolean;
116	  /** Disables the bag button (native `disabled`) when true. `onAddToBag` never fires in that state. */
117	  isUnavailable?: boolean;
118	  onAddToBag?: () => void;
119	
120	  /**
121	   * PLP-only size-chip picker, per the organism's config. Always rendered in the DOM whenever
122	   * true — Figma's `hidden=true` default on this slot is a hover-reveal CSS concern for the
123	   * Step 6 organism, not something this component enforces on itself. See the module docblock's
124	   * `data-card-slot="sizeChips"` note.
125	   */
126	  showSizeChips: boolean;
127	  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[];
128	  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
129	  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;
130	
131	  /**
132	   * True only when the caller has already resolved "unavailable AND a usable notify-me callback
133	   * exists" (the organism's job). This component still independently requires `onNotifyMe` to be
134	   * present before rendering anything — belt-and-braces, the same defensive shape
135	   * `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own `onRemove` + `removeLabel` co-requirement uses.
136	   */
137	  showNotifyMe: boolean;
138	  onNotifyMe?: () => void;
139	};
140	
141	/**
142	 * Molecule — the product-card text-content block: heading/link, bag action, wishlist-only
143	 * colour/size attributes, price, PLP-only size-chip picker, and an out-of-stock notify-me CTA.
144	 * Figma "Card-content" component set, node 40002109:26908 (Desktop 40002109:26906 / Mobile
145	 * 40002163:37103).
146	 *
147	 * Deliberately has NO remove/close button — that action lives entirely in
148	 * `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own `close` overlay (Step 4), positioned on the image, not here.
149	 *
150	 * Also deliberately has no badge slot, despite the SFCC-236 AC mentioning one for PLP/Wishlist.
151	 * An earlier revision of this paragraph claimed no Figma design existed for it at all — that
152	 * was wrong: the badge (Figma "Tag") does exist, confirmed present and identical across every
153	 * Size/Type variant checked. It just lives inside "Image Group", which is
154	 * `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s domain, not this component's — so it was built there instead. See
155	 * that component's own docblock for the confirmed spec, and the organism's own docblock
156	 * ("Badge" note) for which variations actually show it.
157	 *
158	 * Composes `ZimmProductPrice` with `isLive={false}` unconditionally — this is the entire reason
159	 * that prop exists (SFCC-236 Step 3): a grid of these on a PLP must not mount dozens of
160	 * `aria-live` regions whose price never changes post-mount.
161	 */
162	export const ZimmProductCardContent = ({
163	  name,
164	  headingLevel,
165	  href,
166	  currentPrice,
167	  originalPrice,
168	  isPriceLoading,
169	  showAttributes,
170	  colour,
171	  size,
172	  showBag,
173	  isUnavailable,
174	  onAddToBag,
175	  showSizeChips,
176	  sizeChipValues,
177	  selectedSizeChipValue,
178	  onSizeChipSelect,
179	  showNotifyMe,
180	  onNotifyMe,
181	}: ZimmProductCardContentProps) => {
182	  const intl = useIntl();
183	  // `disabled`, not `isUnavailable` — matches `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s own `DEFAULT_STYLE_PROPS`
184	  // key so that guard's exhaustive prop-combination walk actually exercises both the true and
185	  // false branch of `bagButton`'s disabled styling (see zimmProductCardContent.css.ts's own
186	  // comment, and `zimmSizeChip.css.ts`'s identical `disabled` naming for the same reason).
187	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_CONTENT_RECIPE, { disabled: isUnavailable });
188	
189	  // Both conditions required, matching the component contract exactly — not just `showNotifyMe`
190	  // alone, so an organism that sets the flag without wiring a real callback silently renders
191	  // nothing rather than an inert button.
192	  const showNotifyMeButton = showNotifyMe && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
193	
194	  // Figma renders the colour/size attributes line as ONE continuous phrase, not two independent
195	  // labels: the comma is baked into the colour text node's own content ("Lilac Sand,"), not a
196	  // separate punctuation element — confirmed via get_design_context on node 40002187:58446 (the
197	  // real Wishlist Card-content instance). Reproduced the same way here, on the colour value's own
198	  // rendered string (never as a static comma JSX node between the two spans), paired with
199	  // attributesRow's 2px gap (zimmProductCardContent.css.ts) for the "Ivory, M" breathing room —
200	  // verified by rendering the real Futura Round Medium caption style at actual size: the glyph
201	  // ink-to-ink gap the 2px flex gap produces here reads as a genuine (if slightly tighter than
202	  // full-prose) space, not as "Ivory,M" touching. Guarded against `colour` being falsy so a
203	  // caller omitting it (a contract violation, but not this component's job to enforce) still
204	  // renders nothing, rather than the literal string "undefined,".
205	  const colourWithComma = colour ? `${colour},` : colour;
206	
207	  return (
208	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.content}>
209	      <chakra.div __css={styles.nameRow}>
210	        <ProductNameLink to={href} __css={styles.nameLink}>
211	          <ZimmProductName name={name} as={headingLevel} />
212	        </ProductNameLink>
213	
214	        {showBag && (
215	          <chakra.div __css={styles.bagWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.bag}>
216	            <chakra.button
217	              type="button"
218	              __css={styles.bagButton}
219	              aria-label={intl.formatMessage(messages.addToBag)}
220	              disabled={isUnavailable}
221	              onClick={() => {
222	                // Belt-and-braces: the native `disabled` attribute already prevents the browser
223	                // from ever dispatching this click, but stating the invariant explicitly means a
224	                // reader doesn't have to recall that fact to trust onAddToBag can't fire while
225	                // unavailable. Same idiom as ZimmSizeChip's own onClick guard.
226	                if (isUnavailable) return;
227	                onAddToBag?.();
228	              }}
229	            >
230	              <ZimmIcon type="bag" aria-hidden />
231	            </chakra.button>
232	          </chakra.div>
233	        )}
234	      </chakra.div>
235	
236	      {showAttributes && (
237	        <chakra.div __css={styles.attributesRow} data-testid="card-content-attributes">
238	          <chakra.span __css={styles.colourText}>{colourWithComma}</chakra.span>
239	          <chakra.span __css={styles.sizeText}>{size}</chakra.span>
240	        </chakra.div>
241	      )}
242	
243	      <chakra.div __css={styles.priceWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.price}>
244	        <ZimmProductPrice
245	          currentPrice={currentPrice}
246	          originalPrice={originalPrice}
247	          isLoading={isPriceLoading}
248	          isLive={false}
249	        />
250	      </chakra.div>
251	
252	      {showSizeChips && (
253	        <chakra.div __css={styles.sizeChipWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.sizeChips}>
254	          <ZimmSizeChipGroup
255	            values={sizeChipValues ?? []}
256	            selectedValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
257	            onSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
258	          />
259	        </chakra.div>
260	      )}
261	
262	      {showNotifyMeButton && (
263	        <chakra.button
264	          type="button"
265	          __css={styles.notifyMeButton}
266	          onClick={onNotifyMe}
267	          data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.notifyMe}
268	        >
269	          {intl.formatMessage(messages.notifyMe)}
270	        </chakra.button>
271	      )}
272	    </chakra.div>
273	  );
274	};
275	
276	export default ZimmProductCardContent;

import React from 'react';
import { iconSizes } from 'app/theme/foundation';
import {
  ArrowDownIcon,
  ArrowLinkIcon,
  ArrowUpIcon,
  BagIcon,
  BagSelectedIcon,
  CalendarIcon,
  CarouselIcon,
  CarouselSelectedIcon,
  ChatIcon,
  CheckIcon,
  ChevronDownIcon,
  ChevronLeftIcon,
  ChevronRightIcon,
  ChevronUpIcon,
  CloseIcon,
  DeleteIcon,
  EditIcon,
  ExternalLinkIcon,
  InfoIcon,
  InfoSelectedIcon,
  LocationIcon,
  MenuIcon,
  MinusIcon,
  MuteIcon,
  PasswordShowIcon,
  PauseIcon,
  PlayIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  ProfileIcon,
  SearchIcon,
  ShareIcon,
  ShareTwoIcon,
  WishlistIcon,
  FavouritesSolidIcon,
  PhoneIcon,
  WhatsAppIcon,
  EmailIcon,
} from 'app/components/icons';

// Figma iconography spec: node 1892:59595 — 34 of 34 types implemented.
export type ZimmIconType =
  | 'arrow-down'
  | 'arrow-link'
  | 'arrow-up'
  | 'bag'
  | 'bag-selected'
  | 'calendar'
  | 'carousel'
  | 'carousel-selected'
  | 'chat'
  | 'check'
  | 'chevron-down'
  | 'chevron-left'
  | 'chevron-right'
  | 'chevron-up'
  | 'close'
  | 'delete'
  | 'edit'
  | 'external-link'
  | 'info'
  | 'info-selected'
  | 'location'
  | 'menu'
  | 'minus'
  | 'mute'
  | 'password'
  | 'pause'
  | 'play'
  | 'plus'
  | 'profile'
  | 'search'
  | 'share'
  | 'share-2'
  | 'wishlist'
  | 'wishlist-selected'
  // Footer-specific custom icons — not yet in Figma node 1892:59595,
  // pending addition to the iconography spec in the next design sync.
  | 'phone'
  | 'whatsapp'
  | 'email';

export type ZimmIconSize = keyof typeof iconSizes;

type ZimmIconProps = {
  type: ZimmIconType;
  size?: ZimmIconSize;
  /** Pass Chakra token strings or CSS keywords (e.g. 'text.primary', 'currentColor').
   *  Do not pass hardcoded hex values — use theme tokens. */
  color?: string;
} & ({ 'aria-hidden': true; 'aria-label'?: never } | { 'aria-hidden'?: never; 'aria-label': string });

const ICON_MAP = {
  'arrow-down': ArrowDownIcon,
  'arrow-link': ArrowLinkIcon,
  'arrow-up': ArrowUpIcon,
  bag: BagIcon,
  'bag-selected': BagSelectedIcon,
  calendar: CalendarIcon,
  carousel: CarouselIcon,
  'carousel-selected': CarouselSelectedIcon,
  chat: ChatIcon,
  check: CheckIcon,
  'chevron-down': ChevronDownIcon,
  'chevron-left': ChevronLeftIcon,
  'chevron-right': ChevronRightIcon,
  'chevron-up': ChevronUpIcon,
  close: CloseIcon,
  delete: DeleteIcon,
  edit: EditIcon,
  'external-link': ExternalLinkIcon,
  info: InfoIcon,
  'info-selected': InfoSelectedIcon,
  location: LocationIcon,
  menu: MenuIcon,
  minus: MinusIcon,
  mute: MuteIcon,
  password: PasswordShowIcon,
  pause: PauseIcon,
  play: PlayIcon,
  plus: PlusIcon,
  profile: ProfileIcon,
  search: SearchIcon,
  share: ShareIcon,
  'share-2': ShareTwoIcon,
  wishlist: WishlistIcon,
  'wishlist-selected': FavouritesSolidIcon,
  // Footer-specific custom icons — not yet in Figma node 1892:59595,
  // pending addition to the iconography spec in the next design sync.
  phone: PhoneIcon,
  whatsapp: WhatsAppIcon,
  email: EmailIcon,
} as const;

/** Atom — single icon from the Zimmermann icon set. Mirrors zimm-icon contract. */
export const ZimmIcon = ({ type, size = 'md', color = 'currentColor', ...aria }: ZimmIconProps) => {
  const Icon = ICON_MAP[type];
  // Both keys exist in every member of the union (one required, one optional-`never`), so the
  // rest object is indexable directly. The XOR is enforced by ZimmIconProps, not by a cast —
  // casting here only widened 'aria-hidden' from `true | undefined` to `boolean | undefined`.
  const ariaHidden = aria['aria-hidden'];
  const ariaLabel = aria['aria-label'];
  return (
    <Icon
      boxSize={iconSizes[size]}
      color={color}
      aria-hidden={ariaHidden}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      role={ariaLabel ? 'img' : undefined}
    />
  );
};

1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	// Media queries cannot consume var(--zimm-*) custom properties, so the registered foundation
3	// token is imported directly here — the same one deliberate exception documented by
4	// theme/components/footerShared.ts's own `BP` export, and already the established precedent in
5	// this same ui-kits/ tree (zimmDrawer.css.ts, zimmTabs.css.ts, zimmPdpDrawer.css.ts all import it
6	// the same way). No shared module is warranted here: this is the only file in this component's
7	// own folder that needs a breakpoint, unlike footer's three split files.
8	import { breakpoints } from 'app/theme/foundation';
9	
10	/** State the atom feeds in so the recipe can resolve the bag button's disabled treatment —
11	 *  named `disabled`, not `isUnavailable`, to match `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s own
12	 *  `DEFAULT_STYLE_PROPS` key so that guard's exhaustive prop-combination walk actually exercises
13	 *  both branches. Same reasoning `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` documents for its own `disabled` prop. */
14	type ZimmProductCardContentStyleProps = {
15	  disabled?: boolean;
16	};
17	
18	// Same uniform ring every other interactive control in ui-kits/ uses (zimmColourSwatch,
19	// zimmNavItem, zimmColourSwatchGroup's pageButton, zimmProductCardMedia's close/arrowButton/
20	// scrollContainer) — no Figma spec exists for focus on any of this component's three
21	// interactive parts (nameLink, bagButton, notifyMeButton), same situation those precedents were
22	// already in. This gap was caught twice already in this build (Step 2, Step 4); not repeating it.
23	const FOCUS_VISIBLE: SystemStyleObject = {
24	  outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
25	  outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
26	};
27	
28	/**
29	 * Recipe for the product-card text-content block (ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent).
30	 * Figma "Card-content" component set, node 40002109:26908 (Desktop 40002109:26906).
31	 *
32	 * Vertical rhythm is expressed as `marginTop` on each row rather than a uniform `root.gap`,
33	 * because the confirmed Figma offsets are NOT uniform:
34	 *   - 16px between the name row (height 25) and the attributes row (starts at y=41): 41-25=16.
35	 *   - 24px between the name+attributes block (height 49) and the price (starts at y=73): 73-49=24.
36	 *   - 24px between the price frame (height 82) and the (hidden by default) size-selector slot
37	 *     (starts at y=106): 106-82=24.
38	 * These margins apply regardless of which sibling actually precedes a given row (e.g. price's
39	 * marginTop is the same whether or not the attributes row rendered above it) — no distinct value
40	 * is confirmed for that specific combination, so the same rhythm is reused rather than invented.
41	 *
42	 * `root`'s outer padding IS genuinely responsive — a real, confirmed gap, not a missing
43	 * responsive split on an otherwise-correct single value. An earlier revision of this docblock
44	 * asserted nothing correctness-critical differed by breakpoint and shipped `root` with no
45	 * padding at all, on any breakpoint; that claim was never actually checked against the Mobile
46	 * variant and is corrected now that it has been. Confirmed via get_design_context on the two
47	 * real assembled card instances (not just the standalone documentation set):
48	 *   - Desktop (node 40002163:41443, the real assembled Desktop/Default/PLP-PDP card's
49	 *     Card-content): padding-top 32px, padding-inline 40px.
50	 *   - Mobile (node 40002163:37103, the Mobile Card-content variant): padding-top 16px,
51	 *     padding-inline 32px.
52	 * These are genuinely different values, not the same padding read at a smaller viewport, so
53	 * `root` carries an explicit `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})` step (mobile-first: the
54	 * base values are the Mobile ones, overridden at the desktop breakpoint) rather than a single
55	 * baseStyle value — see .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md's "explicit media queries, not
56	 * Chakra's array shorthand" rule.
57	 *
58	 * Parts:
59	 *   - `root` — the outermost flex column; carries the responsive outer padding above.
60	 *   - `nameRow` — Figma's "Product name and icons": the heading link + bag icon, space-between.
61	 *   - `nameLink` — the router `<Link>` wrapping the composed ZimmProductName heading.
62	 *   - `bagWrapper` / `bagButton` — Figma's "Icons" group and its 24x24 `touchContainer` button.
63	 *   - `attributesRow` / `colourText` / `sizeText` — the wishlist-only colour/size meta line.
64	 *   - `priceWrapper` — wraps the composed ZimmProductPrice (always rendered).
65	 *   - `sizeChipWrapper` — wraps the composed ZimmSizeChipGroup (PLP-only when rendered at all).
66	 *   - `notifyMeButton` — the out-of-stock notify-me CTA, the shared CTA/Link atom instance
67	 *     (Figma node 40002163:41468; full citation in index.tsx).
68	 */
69	export const ZimmProductCardContent = {
70	  parts: [
71	    'root',
72	    'nameRow',
73	    'nameLink',
74	    'bagWrapper',
75	    'bagButton',
76	    'attributesRow',
77	    'colourText',
78	    'sizeText',
79	    'priceWrapper',
80	    'sizeChipWrapper',
81	    'notifyMeButton',
82	  ],
83	
84	  baseStyle: ({ disabled }: ZimmProductCardContentStyleProps): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
85	    root: {
86	      display: 'flex',
87	      flexDirection: 'column',
88	      width: '100%',
89	      // Mobile-first base values — Figma node 40002163:37103 (Mobile Card-content variant).
90	      // See the module docblock above for the full citation and why this genuinely differs by
91	      // breakpoint rather than collapsing to one value.
92	      paddingTop: 'var(--zimm-scale-m)', // 16px
93	      paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)', // 32px
94	      [`@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`]: {
95	        // Desktop override — Figma node 40002163:41443 (Desktop/Default/PLP-PDP Card-content).
96	        paddingTop: 'var(--zimm-scale-2xl)', // 32px
97	        paddingInline: 'var(--zimm-scale-3xl)', // 40px
98	      },
99	    },
100	
101	    nameRow: {
102	      display: 'flex',
103	      // 'center', not Figma codegen's own `items-start` approximation for this auto-layout row:
104	      // the "Card heading" (name) and "Icons" touchContainer resolve to different effective
105	      // heights in the real assembled card (name: 8px padding around a 16px line-height ≈ 32px;
106	      // icon: 4px padding around a 16px icon = 24px) — confirmed via get_design_context on node
107	      // 40002163:41441, the real assembled Desktop/Default/PLP-PDP card, not just the standalone
108	      // documentation set. Top-aligning two different-height children produces a visible ~4px
109	      // offset between the icon's optical centre and the name text's optical centre; `center` is
110	      // the robust way to align a text label against a differently-sized icon button in a
111	      // horizontal flex row, and matches what the design visually shows.
112	      alignItems: 'center',
113	      justifyContent: 'space-between',
114	      // 8px — Figma: the 24px icon column starts at x=184 inside the 208px row, and the name
115	      // column is 176px wide (208 - 176 - 24 = 8).
116	      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
117	    },
118	
119	    nameLink: {
120	      display: 'block',
121	      flex: '1 1 auto',
122	      minWidth: 0,
123	      color: 'inherit',
124	      textDecoration: 'none',
125	      _focusVisible: FOCUS_VISIBLE,
126	    },
127	
128	    bagWrapper: {
129	      display: 'flex',
130	      alignItems: 'center',
131	      justifyContent: 'center',
132	      flexShrink: 0,
133	    },
134	
135	    bagButton: {
136	      display: 'flex',
137	      alignItems: 'center',
138	      justifyContent: 'center',
139	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-600)', // 24px — Figma touchContainer, meets WCAG 2.5.8
140	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-600)',
141	      background: 'transparent',
142	      border: 'none',
143	      padding: 0,
144	      color: disabled ? 'var(--zimm-color-text-muted)' : 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
145	      cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
146	      _focusVisible: FOCUS_VISIBLE,
147	    },
148	
149	    attributesRow: {
150	      display: 'flex',
151	      alignItems: 'center',
152	      // 2px — confirmed via get_design_context on node 40002187:58446 (the real Wishlist
153	      // Card-content instance): the Attributes container's two text children have an explicit

305	    showBag: true,
306	    showAttributes: false,

344	/**

358	    name,
359	    headingLevel,

361	    hoverImage,
362	    images,
363	    currentPrice,
364	    originalPrice,

376	  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];
377	
378	  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
379	  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
380	  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
381	  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
382	
383	  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
384	  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
385	  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
386	  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
387	  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
388	  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
389	  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
390	  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
391	  //
392	  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
393	  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
394	  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
395	  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
396	  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
397	  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
398	  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
399	  //
400	  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
401	  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
402	  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
403	  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
404	  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
405	  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean
406	  // for both the size-chip permanent-hide and this new price rule, since both only ever apply to
407	  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
408	  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
409	  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
410	  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);
411	
412	  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
413	  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
414	  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing
415	  // both conditions to the recipe — it only needs to know "hide this on mobile for this render",
416	  // not why.
417	  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));
418	
419	  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;
420	  const resolvedBadge = config.showBadge ? badge : undefined;
421	
422	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_RECIPE, {
423	    hoverHidesPrice,
424	    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
425	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
426	    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
427	    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,
428	    // revealed on hover/focus-visible — every Desktop Unavailable+Hover reference shows it
429	    // appearing only there) but unconditionally visible on touch (every Mobile Unavailable
430	    // reference — the only state a touch pointer ever sees, per the "Mobile has no Hover variant"
431	    // finding — shows it plainly, with no hover to reveal it). This flag is deliberately keyed off
432	    // `showNotifyMe` itself, not `variation`: the confirmed behaviour is identical across all
433	    // three variations, and the recipe's selector simply matches nothing when notify-me isn't
434	    // mounted at all.
435	    hoverRevealsNotifyMe: showNotifyMe,
436	    hideBagOnMobile: bagHiddenOnMobile,
437	  });
438	
439	  return (
440	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-card" data-product-id={id}>
441	      <ZimmProductCardMedia
442	        primaryImage={primaryImage}
443	        hoverImage={hoverImage}
444	        images={images}
445	        swapOnHover={config.showHoverImageSwap && Boolean(hoverImage)}
446	        showControls
447	        badge={resolvedBadge}
448	        onRemove={onRemove}
449	        removeLabel={removeLabel}
450	      />
451	      <ZimmProductCardContent
452	        name={name}
453	        headingLevel={headingLevel}
454	        href={href}
455	        currentPrice={currentPrice}
456	        originalPrice={originalPrice}
457	        isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
458	        showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
459	        colour={colour}
460	        size={size}
461	        showBag={config.showBag}
462	        isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
463	        onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
464	        showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
465	        sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
466	        selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
467	        onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
468	        showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
469	        onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
470	      />
471	    </chakra.div>
472	  );
473	};
474	
475	export default ZimmProductCard;

    capability choice: a tablet with an attached trackpad or mouse (e.g.
    an iPad with a Magic Keyboard) cannot be guaranteed to show the
    indicator, since iPadOS deliberately reports hover:hover/pointer:fine
    once a trackpad is the active input, indistinguishable from a real
    desktop by this query. Confirmed with Marcel this is accepted as-is,
    not a bug to fix.

content.text:
## Method note

My actual tool set for this task was **Read + Bash only** — no Task/sub-agent dispatch tool and no Figma MCP tools (`get_design_context`/`get_screenshot`/`get_metadata`) were present in my function list, despite a mid-session system reminder describing the latter as available. I did not invoke tools that weren't actually given to me. I covered all angles myself sequentially rather than fanning out, and I flag Figma verification as a real, named gap below rather than fabricating MCP calls.

---

## Compiles and passes

Real output, not summarized:

```
$ npx tsc --noEmit; echo "EXIT_CODE=$?"
EXIT_CODE=0
```

```
$ npm run test -- --run
 Test Files  54 passed (54)
      Tests  875 passed (875)
   Duration  22.71s
```

Scoped re-run (just this feature's files, for a clean confirmation):
```
$ npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/{atoms/zimmSizeChip,molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup,molecules/zimmSlideIndicator,molecules/zimmProductCardMedia,molecules/zimmProductCardContent,organisms/zimmProductCard,atoms/zimmProductPrice}
 Test Files  10 passed (10)
      Tests  190 passed (190)
```
`recipeGuards.test.ts` (the hard styling gate) is in the 875: `✓ overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts (6 tests) 28ms`. CONFIRMED clean.

**New finding — `npm run lint` fails at the repo level:**
```
$ npm run lint
✖ 23 problems (5 errors, 18 warnings)
error: Command failed
```
All 5 errors / 18 warnings are in files this branch never touches (`drawer-menu/*`, `header/rightBar/index.tsx`, `product-view/index.tsx`, `zimmContactIconRow/index.stories.tsx`, `useHeaderNav.*`, `pages/product-detail/*`) — none appear in `git diff --stat develop..HEAD`'s 37-file list, and `git log` shows they were last touched by unrelated branches (SFCC-742, SFCC-708, SFCC-731, sfcc-92). `.github/workflows/qa.yml` has no lint step at all, so this isn't a merge gate either way. 🔵 note, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF — pre-existing drift, not this feature's fault, not blocking, but real and worth naming since AGENTS.md lists `npm run lint` as a command.

---

## Internal consistency (does the feature agree with itself)

**Parts/naming/registration convention** — clean across all 6 components. Verified (not assumed): named export matches folder name (PascalCase), `<Component>Props` type naming, `export const X` + `export default X` dual-export pattern, and all 6 recipes registered identically in `theme/components/index.ts` (import + entry, same style as existing entries). My first grep pass for this actually produced false negatives from my own case-sensitivity bug (`zimmSizeChip` folder vs `ZimmSizeChip` export) — caught and corrected before treating it as a finding.

**`:has(:focus-visible)` vs `:focus-within` — 🟡 should-fix, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM.** Commit `983bddf` migrated `zimmProductCard.css.ts` from `:focus-within` to `:has(:focus-visible)` everywhere (confirmed: zero live `:focus-within` selectors remain in any `.css.ts` in this feature). But the *documentation* in `zimmProductCardMedia`'s own file family still asserts, in the present tense, that the organism's mechanism is `:hover`/`:focus-within`:
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx:110`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts:186`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx:77,111`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx:300,302`

This is comment-only (no functional/CSS impact), but it's exactly the "fixed in the file it touched, left stale in the dependent files" shape this sweep exists to catch — a future reader could reintroduce the mouse-click-sticks bug by trusting this comment as ground truth.

**Token reuse for a missing foundation purpose — 🔵 note, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM.** `var(--zimm-color-border-focus)` is reused to mean "static/selected dark outline" (not actually about keyboard focus) in two places: `zimmSizeChip.css.ts:93` (Selected state) and `zimmSizeChipGroup.css.ts:53` (oneSize's border). Category-correct (border token on a border property) but semantically mislabelled — both self-acknowledge this as "pending a real foundation token from the UI designer." Consistent, honest, and low-severity, but it's one real foundation gap surfacing twice, not two independent decisions.

**Intra-step DRY (Angle 8) — 🟡 should-fix, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF.** `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` was correctly extracted to `zimmProductCardShared.ts` because two files needed it identically. The exact same situation exists for the desktop/viewport-width gate and was **not** extracted: `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts:94` writes `` `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})` `` inline; `zimmProductCard.css.ts:19` independently defines `const DESKTOP_QUERY = ...` with the identical template. `zimmProductCard.css.ts`'s own docblock argues "the two files can't drift on what desktop means here" — true for the underlying pixel value, but that's precisely the reasoning that justified extracting `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY`. Not a live bug (both agree today), but a value/pattern typed twice with no shared constant.

**Storybook fixture duplication — 🔵 note, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM, but deliberate.** `PRIMARY_IMAGE`/`HOVER_IMAGE`/`GALLERY_IMAGES` (identical SVG data-URIs, identical alt text) are duplicated verbatim between `zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx:11-26` and `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx:14-29`; `SIZES` (`xs/s/m/l`) is duplicated between `zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx:10-15` and `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx:31-36`. This was tried as a shared `productCardFixtures.ts` and explicitly reverted (commit `3814db6`): *"unlike zimmProductCardShared.ts (a genuine cross-component DOM contract...) this held only Storybook/test sample data... duplicating that across story files is normal and carries no real drift risk."* Flagging per Angle 8's literal wording (repeats even when they currently agree), but noting this is a considered, previously-reversed decision, not an oversight — the task's own reference examples (`footerShared.ts`, `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`) are both production styling values, not test fixtures.

**`acCoverage/` leftover — 🔵 note, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF.** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/acCoverage/` exists on disk but is empty and was never tracked by git (`git ls-files` and `git status` both show nothing for it). Harmless — won't appear in the PR diff — but worth a local cleanup.

**Recipe co-location vs `theme/components/`** — all 6 new recipes are co-located `<name>.css.ts`, consistently, matching the sanctioned newer pattern (footer decomposition precedent) rather than the older centralized style. Correct call given `overrideStyling.md`'s own governance section.

---

## External conformance

**Rules cross-check (`.claude/rules/*`)** — read directly, checked against the whole feature, not file-by-file:
- `overrideStyling.md` hierarchy: `textStyle` used for all type (`buttonSm`, `caption`, `linkSm`), `var(--zimm-*)` used for every colour/spacing value, zero bare Chakra token keys (confirmed both by `recipeGuards.test.ts` passing and by my own read of every recipe). No hardcoded hex/px/rem/em outside the one already-acknowledged `65px` exception (`zimmSizeChipGroup.css.ts:42`, has `audit-allow` comment). Responsive steps use explicit `@media` queries off `breakpoints`, never Chakra array shorthand. Clean.
- `components.md` Storybook categorisation: `Commerce/*` for every commerce-aware component, `Elements/ZimmSlideIndicator` for the one genuinely generic, non-commerce-aware component — internally consistent and matches the "what does it know about" test.
- `testing.md`: layer selection is correct throughout (Vitest for logic/resolvers, Storybook `play` for the one genuinely interactive case, `within(canvasElement)` used correctly). The `ZimmIcon`-under-Vitest workaround doesn't apply here since neither `ZimmIcon` nor any base icon barrel component is rendered inside a Vitest-mocked useMultiStyleConfig context that would hit that gap.
- `typescript.md`: discriminated union used correctly for `ZimmProductCardProps` (verified via the `@ts-expect-error` cases cited in `index.test.tsx`), utility types used instead of hand-copied duplicates (`ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel`, `ZimmProductCardImage`), no bare `any`.

**Icon-import pattern — checked and clean, initially looked like a finding, retracted after verification.** `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` imports `ChevronLeftIcon`/`ChevronRightIcon`/`CloseIcon` directly from `'../../../icons'` rather than through the `ZimmIcon` wrapper atom (which does support all three types). I checked whether this was an ad hoc inconsistency against `zimmProductCardContent`'s use of `ZimmIcon` for its bag icon — it isn't: `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:6` (the explicit PR #64 exemplar) uses the **identical** direct-import pattern for its own pagination chevrons. `zimmProductCardMedia` is faithfully following established precedent, not diverging.

**Exemplar comparison (PR #64: zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatchGroup)** — `zimmSizeChip`/`zimmSizeChipGroup`'s roving-tabindex mechanism (`hasNavigated`/`shouldRefocus` ref, `data-*-value` attribute lookup for index derivation, `role="radiogroup"` + `role="radio"` children) closely mirrors `zimmColourSwatchGroup`'s shape, with one deliberate, documented refinement (`computeFocusIndex` as a standalone pure function vs. inline derivation) — a considered evolution, not a divergence.

**Figma end-to-end — could not independently verify (see "What I could not verify").** Every Figma node ID and confirmed-value claim in this feature's ~30 docblocks is the implementation's own citation. I cross-checked the *arithmetic* behind every pixel-value comment against the actual foundation registry (see below) and found zero fabrications, but I have no way to confirm the citations themselves against the live Figma file.

Pixel-math spot-check (falsification attempt — tried to catch a comment claiming a value the token doesn't actually have):
```
$ grep -n "scale-700\|scale-1200\|scale-025\|scale-600\|scale-300" overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts
'--zimm-scale-025': '1px',
'--zimm-scale-300': spacing.s, // 12px
'--zimm-scale-600': spacing.xl, // 24px
'--zimm-scale-700': '28px',
'--zimm-scale-1200': '48px',
```
All match what the six new recipes' comments claim (28px chip, 48px close/badge, 1px indicator, 24px touch targets, 12px arrow insets). Clean.

**Recipe state exhaustiveness — PLAUSIBLE, could not fully verify, open question worth raising directly.** No recipe in this feature implements a Chakra `_hover` pseudo-state on any individual control (only `_focusVisible`; the organism's raw `:hover` selectors are a different mechanism — a card-wide visibility swap, not a per-control style). `zimmSizeChip.css.ts:54` explicitly rules out hover for its own chip via a cited Figma variant-set absence. No equivalent "Figma has no hover state" citation exists for `bagButton`/`notifyMeButton`/`nameLink` (`zimmProductCardContent.css.ts:18-22` only rules out **focus**, not hover) or for `close`/`arrowButton` in `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`. I cannot confirm from source alone whether Figma defines an undesigned hover treatment for these five controls.

**Tier-touching — 🔵 note, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF, process observation only.** Commit `79dcc67` bundles a Tier 1 change (`theme/foundation/typography.ts:161-169`, `linkSm.textTransform: capitalize→uppercase`) and its Tier 2 mirror (`theme/globalStyles.ts:89`) into the same commit as new Tier-4 component work — literally "spans multiple protection tiers" (Hard Rule #10). The value change itself is well-justified (Figma node 40002163:41468 cited, both mirrors changed in sync) and low-risk (`grep -rl linkSm overrides/` shows zero consumers outside this feature today, so nothing else can regress). I can't verify whether out-of-band UI-designer/tier-1-approver sign-off happened; flagging for completeness, not asserting a violation.

---

## Tokens (`node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`)

```
❌ 1 raw value(s) with no acknowledged exception:
  overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts:20  '59.125em'
```
Not this feature's file — out of scope per the task's own instruction (only new unacknowledged findings in touched files are mine to report). Zero new unacknowledged raw-value violations in any of the 37 touched files. The one acknowledged exception in-scope (`zimmSizeChipGroup.css.ts:42`, `65px`) is correctly flagged with `audit-allow`.

**Semantic-intent check (new, not script-covered) — one real mismatch found:** `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts:56` — `background: isActive ? 'var(--zimm-color-bg-05)' : 'var(--zimm-color-border-secondary)'`. The inactive branch puts a `border.*`-category token on a `background` property — a genuine category mismatch, not just a specific-meaning quibble. 🟡 should-fix, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF (the sharper category violation; related to but distinct from the `border-focus` reuse noted above). Self-acknowledged at length in-file (comment explains no `background.*` equivalent for `border.secondary` exists yet) and confirmed visually correct today only by coincidence (both resolve to the same `grey/900` hex). Missing token: a `--zimm-color-background-*` alias for "flat, opaque light-grey surface fill," distinct from `bg-05`.

I swept every `var(--zimm-color-*)` line across all 6 recipes for this category check (not just this one) — every other usage (`color:`↔`text.*`/`link.*`, `border(-color):`↔`border.*`) is category-correct.

---

## Structure / Imports / Accessibility

All clean, verified directly rather than assumed:
- **Structure**: 4-file layout present everywhere; `.css.test.ts` exists for the 3 components with standalone resolver logic (`zimmSizeChip`, `zimmSizeChipGroup`, `zimmSlideIndicator`) and is folded into `index.test.tsx` as a "real recipe assertions" block for the 3 larger, render-coupled components (`zimmProductCardMedia`, `zimmProductCardContent`, `zimmProductCard`) — a defensible split (recipe assertions cross-reference render-level Fix regressions in the larger files), not an unexplained inconsistency.
- **Imports**: zero circular imports, max relative depth 3 (`'../../../icons'`), zero base-SFCC-path imports of an overridden component (none of the 6 shadow a base component), no data-fetching hooks in any leaf (`grep` for any `use[A-Z]...` beyond `useState/useEffect/useRef/useMultiStyleConfig/useIntl` returned nothing).
- **Accessibility**: every `chakra.img` has a required (non-optional in the type) `alt`; every icon-only button has `aria-label` (bag, close, prev/next arrow); the 2 buttons without `aria-label` (size-chip, notify-me) both have real visible text as their accessible name; every `onClick` in the feature is on a native `<button>` — zero on a `div`/`span`/`Box`.

---

## React logic correctness

Both places in this feature that seed state from a prop on mount and must resync on rerender have real, working fixtures for exactly the edge case requested — verified by reading the test code, not just confirming its existence:
- `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx:69` (`useState(() => computeFocusIndex(values, selectedValue))`) — `index.test.tsx:130-172` rerenders with a new `selectedValue` and with a size that becomes disabled after mount, asserting the tab stop moves correctly both times.
- `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx:156,182-184` (`currentIndex` re-clamped via functional updater when `totalSlides` shrinks) — `index.test.tsx:351-381` navigates to the last of 3 images, rerenders with a shrunk 2-image array, and asserts the *very next* click wraps correctly (not just that the display looks right immediately after the shrink, which the indicator's own clamp would mask).

No functional-updater misuse found; both effects correctly use the `prev =>` form where the previous value is genuinely needed.

---

## Against the ticket

Could not verify against the actual SFCC-236 AC text — no Jira tool available, and no local `.docs/temp/SFCC-236-*` or plan file exists in the repo (checked). What I *can* confirm: the code is internally coherent with its own extensively-cited understanding of the AC (e.g., the `:focus-within`→`:has(:focus-visible)` fix is applied everywhere the AC's "arrows appear on hover" requirement is implemented; the Dani-vs-AC badge/hover-swap judgment calls are applied consistently in `VARIATION_CONFIG`). This is a check of self-consistency, not of correctness against the ticket itself.

---

## Visual checkpoint brief

I could not independently confirm any row against live Figma (no MCP tool in my toolset — see below). Every "Expected value" below is the implementation's own citation; this table is a punch list for Marcel to run through DevTools + Figma directly, prioritized toward items my own review flagged as open questions or as previously-buggy ("Fix" callouts, i.e. highest regression risk).
